name: LockWorkstationNode
label: Lock Workstation
description: Locks the workstation's display to protect it from unauthorized use. Optionally forces lock even if workstation doesn't support it.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ForceLock
fields.label: Force Lock
fields.description: When true, will attempt alternative methods if standard lock fails

fields.name: Success
fields.label: Success
fields.description: Indicates whether the workstation was successfully locked

fields.name: MethodUsed
fields.label: Method Used
fields.description: Describes which locking method was successful
